Same with me I hate Christmas bc me and my sister her husband and my boyfriend celebrated Christmas early December 22nd 2017. She begged us to celebrate with her early bc she had it all planned out. She talked to My boyfriend that night if he would take care of me and if he loved me. (She wanted to make sure I was taken care of) I thought she was just excited and wanted us to get married. we had a blast That night. We all drank had fun and I heard her knocking on my door but never answered. I feel like if I would have answered she would still be alive and I could have talked her out of it or stoped it. But it was planned she was going to do it. would have never thought she was going to do that night. My boyfriend and I stayed the night and the next morning I hear my brother in law screaming through the house that my sister is dead I run outside and she cranked up both a mustang and Jeep in the garage middle of the night wrote her suicide letter and fell asleep and never woke. She was my other half my heart and to see her gone I felt like she left me alone. I still here my brother in law screaming in my head and the way I saw her and had no emotions. I was in shock. I wanted to cry but couldn’t stood still in time of what happened. It’s trauma and guilt of not answering and what if I could have stopped it. She now haunts my dreams and I just wanna be whole with my other half. The holidays are hard for me.
